name: stationary bike walk
description: Pedalling out of the saddle on a stationary bike, standing on the pedals as if walking uphill. It works the legs and raises the heart rate.
instructions: Set a moderate resistance and hold the handlebar.
Rise off the saddle and stand on the pedals with your body upright.
Pedal slowly, pushing each pedal down as if climbing stairs.
Keep your hips over the pedals and your core braced.
Keep a steady rhythm for the planned time, then sit down to cool off.
